summary: Bevy stepping, full-f64 rigid bodies, IMU measurements and a constrained SDF scene loader are reviewed. The complete server slice is still in progress.

active.title: Headless exact-step CLI
active.detail: SDF file input and deterministic step control implemented; error-path coverage must pass before acceptance.

active.title: Quality gates and integration review
active.detail: Staged-tree coverage is enforced. Full profile matrix and changed-line enforcement remain open.

accepted_slices.title: Bevy core, f64 Rapier probes and noise-free IMU
SDF scene construction, full inertia and reset-safe IMU sampling

remaining: Complete exact-step SDF server with clock/pose/IMU transport and a C++ comparison.
DART, MuJoCo and TPE adapters; joints, forces, complete capability contract.
Bevy rendering, asset pipeline, sensor scheduling/noise and remaining sensor families.
All 78 system migrations, native plugin ABI, full world/logging/scripting/CLI behavior.
Complete upstream parity, feature coverage, comparative performance and release qualification.

quality.note: Counts and hosted CI cover the reviewed four-crate revision; each crate exceeds 95% lines and regions. CLI working-tree region coverage currently fails. Selected C++ reference cases pass; no performance gain has been measured.
